notes: Held-out tasks (round 2), written after v0.2's tuning and before any kopt measurement on them; not derived from bench/results/failures.md. Gold read in the code with git grep and sed only. Re-check with `kopt bench bench/tasks-heldout/meilisearch.json --verify`.

tasks.question: How is the secret value of an API key derived from its uid and the master key?
tasks.search: api key value derived from uid master key
tasks.verifiedBy: Read meilisearch-auth: AuthController::generate_key calls generate_key_as_hexa(uid, master_key), an HMAC-SHA256 of the uid keyed by the master key, hex encoded.

tasks.question: Where does Meilisearch check that an API key may perform an action on a given index and has not expired?
tasks.search: api key authorized action index expiration date
tasks.verifiedBy: Read AuthController::is_key_authorized: looks up the expiration date for (uid, action, all indexes) then (uid, action, index) through HeedAuthStore::get_expiration_date and compares it with now.
